ISSUE 1: Hard-coded Beta Flags
================================================================================
File: sdk/tools/anthropic_web_search/web_search.go (Line 283-301)

BEFORE:
  betas: []BetaFlag{
    BetaClaudeCode,
    BetaInterleavedThinking,
  },

AFTER:
  betas:        make([]BetaFlag, 0),  // Start with empty betas, add only what's needed
  model:        "claude-sonnet-4-20250514", // Default model for web search

IMPACT: Removes unnecessary beta flags that were hard-coded by default


ISSUE 2: Missing OAuth Beta Constant

ADDED CONSTANT:

    // OAuth-related betas (CRITICAL for OAuth token authentication)
    BetaOAuth BetaFlag = "oauth-2025-04-20"  // REQUIRED for OAuth tokens
    // ...
  )

UPDATED WithOAuth():
  BEFORE: if b == "oauth-2025-04-20" {
  AFTER:  if b == BetaOAuth {

IMPACT: Uses named constant instead of hard-coded string


ISSUE 3: Missing User-Agent Header
================================================================================
File: sdk/tools/anthropic_web_search/web_search.go (Lines 384-396)

ADDED LINE:
  httpReq.Header.Set("User-Agent", "claude-cli/2.1.2 (external, cli)")

WHEN: Only when OAuth is enabled (inside if c.isOAuth block)

IMPACT: Adds required User-Agent header for proper OAuth routing


ISSUE 4: Hard-coded Model
================================================================================

FILE 1: sdk/tools/anthropic_web_search/web_search.go

ADDED TO Client STRUCT (Line 189):
  model string // Model to use for web search requests

ADDED NEW FUNCTION (Lines 275-280):
  func WithModel(model string) ClientOption {
    return func(c *Client) {
      if model != "" {
        c.model = model
      }
    }
  }

IMPACT: Makes model configurable via ClientOption


FILE 2: sdk/tools/anthropic_web_search/tool.go

ADDED TO Tool STRUCT (Lines 26-30):
  type Tool struct {
    config WebSearchConfig
    model  string  // NEW: Optional model override
  }

ADDED NEW CONSTRUCTOR (Lines 52-58):
  func NewWithModel(config WebSearchConfig, model string) *Tool {
    return &Tool{
      config: config,
      model:  model,
    }
  }

UPDATED New() and NewWithConfig():
  - Added: model:  "", // Will use client default

UPDATED Execute() METHOD (Lines 188-230):
  OLD:
    client := NewClient(token.AccessToken,
      WithOAuth(true),
      WithWebSearch(t.config),
      WithBetas(BetaWebSearch),
    )
    // ... later ...
    req := &APIRequest{
      Model:     "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",

  NEW:
    clientOpts := []ClientOption{
      WithOAuth(true),
      WithWebSearch(t.config),
      WithBetas(BetaWebSearch),
    }
    
    if t.model != "" {
      clientOpts = append(clientOpts, WithModel(t.model))
    }
    
    client := NewClient(token.AccessToken, clientOpts...)
    
    // ... later ...
    
    modelToUse := client.model
    if modelToUse == "" {
      modelToUse = "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
    }
    
    req := &APIRequest{
      Model:     modelToUse,

IMPACT: Model is now configurable at three levels
  1. Tool level: NewWithModel(config, "custom-model")
  2. Client level: WithModel("custom-model")
  3. Default: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
